Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: first-person game environment visual-development mockup, Sanctuary city fountain square, image 1 of a cohesive architectural reference set for a C++ grid-based dungeon crawler. Generate one wide landscape image, 16:9.
Primary request: an original compact medieval fantasy sanctuary town, older and slightly overgrown but still maintained and inhabitable. Architectural inspiration is early 1990s first-person dungeon-crawler town environments: thick warm stone walls, chunky rounded arches, dark timber doors, deep window recesses, compact roof silhouettes. Do not reproduce an existing game scene.
Composition: standing at normal human eye height on a straight flat flagstone street entering a modest enclosed town square; level camera, strong readable cardinal/grid-aligned building footprints, horizon in upper third, no overhead or isometric view. A modest octagonal low-poly stone fountain with a short central water spout occupies the middle distance, with generous walkable paving on both sides. Houses frame the square; mostly one storey, one clearly two-storey house with small upper windows. Show a side street continuing between buildings.
Architecture: honey-grey limestone rubble masonry and worn pale ochre lime plaster, substantial visibly three-dimensional round stone door surrounds with wedge-shaped voussoirs, recessed arched dark oak plank doors with dull iron straps, small inset shuttered windows; simple low-polygon dark weathered slate gabled roofs and distinct eaves. A few mossy joints, restrained ivy on one facade, weeds at wall bases. One leafy tree and low planted bushes. Two simple timber market stalls with faded muted rust and sage canvas at an edge of the square, clear pedestrian circulation.
Style: credible actual retro 3D game view made of simple low-poly meshes and detailed hand-painted pixel textures; crisp readable geometry, subtly pixelated texture detail, consistent material scale, grounded proportions, baked painted recess and eave shading, restrained ambient daylight. Beautiful but feasible as a small modular Blender kit. Desaturated blue-grey sky, warm stone, dark brown timber, olive foliage, quiet welcoming age. Foliage in simple textured clusters. Water modest and stylized.
Constraints: full-bleed environment only, no UI, no text, no logo, no people, no weapons, no cursor, no painterly brush-stroke concept-art haze, no photorealistic PBR, no cinematic depth of field, no bloom, no grand cathedral/castle, no steep stairs, no elaborate high-poly sculpture, no ruined abandoned city, no dense jungle, no exaggerated cartoon proportions. This is an art target, not an engine screenshot.

Primary request: an original compact medieval fantasy sanctuary town, older and slightly overgrown but inhabited and maintained. Match this visual vocabulary: honey-grey limestone and pale ochre worn plaster, thick wedge-stone rounded doorway arches, recessed dark oak iron-strapped plank doors, dark weathered slate gables, timber eave brackets, subdued olive greenery, crisp hand-painted pixel-textured low-poly game art. Inspired by classic early 1990s first-person dungeon-crawler towns, not copying any game scene.
Composition: normal human eye-height first-person view from a flat flagstone lane at a small right-angle junction. Level camera, horizon in upper third, no aerial/isometric view. Compact simple grid-aligned houses; straight lane leads ahead to a small planted courtyard with a mature leafy tree and low stone planting bed, with a clear side passage at the junction. Paving is walkable and uncluttered. A close one-storey house facade on one side gives a useful three-quarter view of a deeply recessed ROUND arched entrance: chunky individual stone voussoirs, real reveal thickness, dark wooden curved-top plank door with two dull iron straps and a modest ring handle. Another house has paired narrow arched timber doors and an inset small shuttered window. Include one two-storey corner house further along, upper storey worn plaster with restrained exposed timber framing, small shuttered windows, a simple gabled roof and modest chimney. Roofs step in height and show sky between buildings.
Age and vegetation: ivy climbs part of the corner building without covering its architecture; moss at wall feet and between some paving stones, a few bushes and tiny weeds, believable still-used town, not a ruin. Subtle material and door variation within one cohesive kit. Quiet and sheltered.
Style: credible actual retro 3D game view made of simple low-poly meshes with detailed hand-painted pixel textures, clean silhouettes and large readable forms; subtly pixelated detail but not coarse blocky voxels. Consistent physical texture scale, strong painted dark doorway recesses and undersides of eaves, restrained soft ambient daylight, blue-grey sky. A feasible modular Blender environment with painted shading rather than cinematic lighting.
Constraints: full-bleed environment only; no UI, text, logos, cursor, characters or weapons; no photorealistic PBR, no painterly concept-art brushwork or haze, no bloom or depth of field, no crooked whimsical buildings, no enormous castle, no dense jungle or ruined city, no stairs or hills. Do not make a second fountain-square composition: this image is the intimate street, house heights, door variation, and arch depth reference. This is an art target, not an engine screenshot.
